title: 폭우 재택
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop R&B and Neo-Soul. Electric piano plays jazzy, extended chords with a Rhodes-like timbre. A clean electric guitar provides rhythmic accents with muted strums and occasional melodic fills. The bass guitar follows a syncopated, groovy pattern. Drums consist of a crisp snare, a tight kick, and subtle hi-hat work. Male vocals are smooth and melodic, utilizing a mix of chest voice and light falsetto. The arrangement features a laid-back, mid-tempo groove in 4/4 time. Key is G Major, tempo is 92 BPM. Production is clean with light reverb on the vocals and a warm, analog-style saturation on the instruments.
